integrity: Proof is explicit and the companion Python verifier uses exact rational integration. The analytic infinite-parameter theorem is not established by finite enumeration. Scientific priority could be affected by an unindexed equivalent.
scientific_limitations: The theorem describes continuous shared-phase pairwise Bernoulli carries; it does not describe full integer-sampled p-adic valuation dependence or higher-order positive association. The classical sawtooth covariance kernel and earlier central-coordinate boundary are not novel components.
title: Positive dependence and exact covariance of common-phase Kummer carry indicators
